description.value: The Satellite Bar & Grille is the clubhouse restaurant at Arbutus Ridge Golf Club, an 18-hole Bill Robinson-designed course nestled in Cobble Hill with sweeping views of Satellite Channel and Mount Baker. The restaurant overlooks the 18th fairway and serves golfers and guests in a coastal setting that has earned the club recognition including Golf Shop of the Year on Vancouver Island. A progressive dress code is enforced throughout the clubhouse.

address.value: 3515 Telegraph Rd, Cobble Hill, BC V8H 0E1
